title: Policy file (policy/*.yaml)

field.description: Argument name (dot path) the checker applies to.
field.title: Field

ControlConfig.description: One configured control instance. `type` selects the implementation in the registry.

action.description: Override the action the control emits on a hit.

presets.description: Only active under these presets; null = all.
presets.title: Presets

locked.description: Cannot be disabled or edited from the panel.
locked.title: Locked

params.description: Type-specific parameters, validated by the control's Params model.
params.title: Params

ControlConfig.title: ControlConfig

DataClass.description: Confidentiality classes, ordered from least to most sensitive.
DataClass.title: DataClass

InspectionPoint.description: Where in the traffic flow a payload is inspected (concept §6.1).
InspectionPoint.title: InspectionPoint

origin.description: Expected server identity/origin bound at initialize.
origin.title: Origin

sensitive_external_action.description: Sensitive data sent to a model not allowed for its class.

gpu_seconds_per_1k_tokens.description: Estimate used when the upstream reports no timings (vLLM/SGLang).
gpu_seconds_per_1k_tokens.title: Gpu Seconds Per 1K Tokens

RiskCutoffs.description: Composite risk score → graded action (concept §6.5). Must be ascending.
RiskCutoffs.title: RiskCutoffs

degraded.description: Local fallback when budgets are exhausted or a cloud connector is down.
degraded.title: Degraded

pattern.description: regex/arg_pattern/url_path: RE2-compatible regex; yara: rule source; ioc_domain: domain (subdomains match); *_hash: sha256 hex; opcode: `module.attr` glob; package_version: `<ecosystem>:<name>` with versions in metadata.versions.
pattern.title: Pattern

stages.description: Where to match; empty = every stage applicable to the type.
stages.title: Stages

local_rules.description: Rules that apply even when the feed is unreachable.
local_rules.title: Local Rules

template.description: Prompt template with `{field}` placeholders from input_schema.
template.title: Template

examples.description: Example prompts for kNN task matching.
examples.title: Examples

holdback_chars.description: Egress hold-back window for streaming moderation.
holdback_chars.title: Holdback Chars

Taxonomy.description: Framework tags attached to rules and events (concept §13).
Taxonomy.title: Taxonomy

server.description: MCP server id; null = client built-in tool.
server.title: Server

name.description: Upstream tool name if different from the id suffix.
name.title: Name

arguments_schema.description: Pinned argument JSON Schema; unknown fields are always rejected.
arguments_schema.title: Arguments Schema

tier.description: Override the tool's default tier for this group.

description: One policy file. Every section is optional; a section may appear in only one file.
